messages:
incident-bot: :warning: Canary group "staging/fastlane" is reporting tokenization failures and decode errors. 87 failures in 4m. sample:
```
2026-03-17T15:45:12Z error: tokenizer mismatch, token_id=65535 during decode
artifact: model:v2b+weights@sha256:ab12cd
tokenizer_tag: tokenizer:v1
```

tanya.ops: Acknowledged. Pausing the staged rollout now and paging oncall.

alicia.release: Confirming — the staging promotion pipeline promoted model:v2b earlier today. I see artifact metadata token_tag=tokenizer:v1 which is wrong; expected tokenizer:v2b. Suspect packaging job used stale manifest.

jon.eng: On it. Flipping the rollout flag and routing canary requests back to model:prod-stable.

sam.oncall: Running kill-switch:
```
curl -s -X POST https://flags.internal/api/set -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG" -d '{"rollout_model_v2":false}'
# response: {"status":"ok","rollout_model_v2":false}
```

sam.oncall: Rollout disabled. Routing reverted. Monitoring traffic now.

priya.cs: Small bump in error rate observed for customer BetaCorp between 15:44-15:46 (approx 0.8% of their requests returned 500). CS notified; no escalations yet.

tanya.ops: Good job. We need an immediate mitigation plus follow-up fixes: 1) stop promotions until validation added (done), 2) republish artifact with correct tokenizer tag and smoke test, 3) add CI gate to verify artifact.tokenizer_tag matches the built tokenizer and run quick tokenization verification.

alicia.release: I'll add a pre-publish checker to the packaging pipeline. Pseudo-check:
```
if artifact.tokenizer_tag != expected_tokenizer:
  abort("tokenizer tag mismatch")
run_tokenizer_smoke_test(artifact, sample_inputs)
```
ETA for CI patch: ~1.5h, will hotfix job pipeline.

jon.eng: Also adding runtime guard — loader will assert that the tokenizer version referenced by the weight bundle matches the tokenizer instance loaded at boot; fail fast if mismatch to avoid silent canary load.

priya.cs: Creating incident INC-2301 for tracking and customer communication. I'll draft a short note for BetaCorp in case they file a ticket.

sam.oncall: Canary error rate returned to baseline within 90s after rollback. 5m window now shows 0.01% errors. Closing pager but keeping the incident open for postmortem.

tanya.ops: Owners: jon.eng (root cause + runtime guard), alicia.release (pipeline fix), tanya.ops (incident coordination + comms). We'll run a blameless postmortem and track the CI validation as a must-fix.

alicia.release: I'll push a small test artifact republish after the CI gate is up; will annotate the artifact with the tokenizer hash and include a tokenization golden sample.

jon.eng: Quick note for follow-up: add an artifact integration test that loads model+tokenizer in a container and runs a couple of decoding samples. That should catch mismatches pre-promotion.

priya.cs: Marking severity S2 due to brief customer impact and start of customer outreach.

tanya.ops: Thanks everyone. Will post the full timeline and action items in #incidents follow-up once we close the postmortem. Handing off monitoring to alicia.release for the next promotion attempt.
